name: Founders & Builders collaboration commands
transport: HTTPS JSON commands; this endpoint is not an A2A protocol server
authentication: Bearer task-scoped credential issued by the person in the signed-in workspace

agent_operations.readTask: Read only the authorized contribution brief; requires read permission.
agent_operations.matchTask: Check this task against the owner's saved skills, time and compensation preferences; requires read permission.
agent_operations.readContribution: Read the owner's authorized collaboration stage and current version; requires read permission and contributionId.
agent_operations.activity: Read authorized activity including human/agent attribution; requires read permission.
agent_operations.interest: Apply with a note when explicitly permitted. Match-constrained grants enforce the saved profile.
agent_operations.message: Send a participant question when explicitly permitted; use current expectedVersion.
agent_operations.propose: Propose scope when explicitly permitted. Exact-brief grants cannot rewrite terms; use current expectedVersion.
agent_operations.deliver: Submit notes/evidence only after the person confirms the exact terms; use current expectedVersion. Execution requires your own agent tools.

limits: Server checks task scope, selected actions, request budget, task minutes, expiry and revocation on every request. No background executor is provided by this page.
discovery: Global private records cannot be listed with an agent credential. Begin with a task and grant explicitly selected by its owner.
availability: Review contract: matchTask and readContribution require the pending cloud deployment approval. The fictional preview issues no real credentials.
